title: Xenophobia and the African Condition: A Call for Sobriety
desc: Scenes of violent attacks on Africans in South Africa have horrified many of the continent’s daughters and sons. I share that sense of overwhelming revulsion. Xenophobia, in all its forms, is an affront to our common humanity. Yet revulsion, on its own, is not analysis. And Africa’s crises demand analysis, not sentiment.
